ticket: J8 (#1261): the owner, 2026-11-14: "add ALOT more images to the UI. especially on stuff you can do."
prompt:
Use only the two pictures attached to this message (ignore any earlier pictures). They are tile sheets already in this painted isometric golf game: match their style, scale, framing, camera angle, detail level and colours exactly.

Create an image, 4:3 landscape: a sheet of TWELVE tiny isometric dioramas in a 4 x 3 grid. Each scene sits on its own small slab of ground, on its own dark navy (#1E2A44) rounded square; the twelve squares are the same size, evenly spaced, and do not touch, on a flat charcoal (#1C1F26) background. Light from the upper right, soft shadows falling to the lower left, warm autumn colours, the year 1985 (no modern things). NO lettering, numbers, logos or symbols anywhere: every sign, board, paper, tag and screen is blank. No people. Each scene must be easy to tell apart from the others at a small size, with one clear main object. Row by row, left to right:
Row 1: (1) an old weathered driving-range gate standing open with a ring of keys hanging on the gatepost and a blank wooden board; (2) a green rubber hitting mat with a wire bucket full of white golf balls and a driver lying across it, one ball on a rubber tee; (3) a wedge and a putter crossed on closely mown fringe grass beside a hole cup, three balls around it; (4) a junk pile on bare dirt: stacked old tyres, a rusty bicycle and a broken crate, with a wheelbarrow and a rake beside it.
Row 2: (5) a shag-bag ball picker tube standing in rough dry grass with white golf balls scattered around it and a half-filled wire basket; (6) a hand-pushed ball collector (a wheeled roller that gathers golf balls) with a staff cap and a work jacket hanging on a wooden post; (7) a ball-washing machine: a galvanised tub with a crank and brushes, clean white balls in a wire basket and dirty ones in a crate; (8) a wire bucket of golf balls on a small counter with a blank paper price tag tied to it and a few stacks of coins.
Row 3: (9) a roll of fresh green turf half unrolled over bare dirt, with a turf knife; (10) a lawn sprinkler spraying an arc of water over a patch that is half bare dirt and half new bright grass; (11) a small round target green with a red flag out on rough ground, a blank white marker board on a post beside it; (12) three hitting bays side by side under a simple corrugated tin roof on timber posts, a mat in each.
generator: ChatGPT image generation through the chatgpt-bridge (D:/AI/chatgpt-bridge), 2026-11-14
lighting: screen upper-right toward lower-left; soft shadows to the lower left; warm autumn colours; 1985
